ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure is a circle with V as the center, Q and S are on the same horizontal straight line, and QS is a diameter. The center V is connected to points such as S, T, and P with radii. The figure marks the central angle ∠SVT = 75°, and the central angle ∠TVP = 72°. Then reason: The measure of a central angle is equal to the measure of its corresponding intercepted arc, so the measure of arc ST is 75°, and the measure of arc TP is 72°. The requested arc STP represents the arc from S to P and passing through T, therefore it is composed of arc ST and arc TP. Adding gives m\widehat{STP} = 75 + 72 = 147.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as a circle centered at V with two central angles marked: ∠SVT = 75° and ∠TVP = 72°.
